description: Narrow capability for reader windows, which show one workspace document apart from the main window. Their labels are derived from the document they show (see crates/specforge/src/reader.rs), so they are matched by glob. It grants the core baseline, closing itself on Escape or Cmd/Ctrl-W, and exactly the application commands the reader surface calls: the workspace and file listings it resolves its address against, the two document reads and their watch pair, the checked workspace link opener, the reading-width read, and its own remembered-size setter. It grants no pull-request, review-action, settings, provider or window-opening command (pull-request-actions: Application Commands Are Granted Per Window Kind).
